chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The best mosques for your women are the homes."

key_terms.خَيْرُ: the best; indicating superiority and preference
key_terms.مَسَاجِدِ: places of sajdah and prayer; places of worship

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the best place of prayer for women?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the most suitable place of worship for women is the home. It conveys a legal-ethical teaching related to worship and family life within the Islamic framework.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.718 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The best mosques for your women are their homes."
